securityAdvisors.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
securityAdvisors.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
securityAdvisors.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.
securityAdvisors.detail: Function `public.is_blocked_between(user_a uuid, user_b uuid)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/is_blocked_between`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

securityAdvisors.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
securityAdvisors.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
securityAdvisors.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.
securityAdvisors.detail: Function `public.create_or_resolve_user_submitted_entity(p_entity_type text, p_display_name text, p_country_code text, p_city text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/create_or_resolve_user_submitted_entity`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
